name: Felix Rubio
life: “I still remember getting invited into the dining room after washing up.” Thursday often includes a stop at the corner by Juniper Tailor, where Felix looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I cook her Sunday lunch. She's invited me to eat my own food with the guests this time.
appearance: Felix has an aquiline nose and a square chin. Look for dark brown curls cut close behind the ears. Away from the heat of the kitchen, the familiar outfit is a soft blue checked shirt with a little coil of soft measuring tape. In conversation Felix takes off the watch before a long conversation.
personality: Felix has a talent for getting adversaries to laugh at exactly the same thing. Felix knows better than to expect the laugh to settle what they are arguing about.
agenda: To eat a whole meal with the client this Sunday.
family: Scout Marin is Felix’s older cousin. Felix brings a spare shopping bag. Scout chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *Winter afloat*, Scout says, “I can offer a sofa but my son needs a place to come back to when he's sober.”
connections: Dennis Perry. The home cook gets to sit beside the person who ironed the collar.

reactions.situation: The diner wants to fasten the new cuff unaided
reactions.response: Felix leaves the cuff in reach and lets the diner set the pace.
